| `layout.padding` | `EdgeInsets` | a number (all sides) or [left, top, right, bottom] |
| `layout.rotation` | `double` | a number |
| `layout.aspectRatio` | `double` | a number |
| `layout.flex` | `int` | a whole number |
| `layout.squeezable` | `bool` | `true` or `false` |
| `layout.x` | `AxisPosition` | a number (distance from the start) or {"start": d}, {"end": d}, {"start": a, "end": b}, {"align": -1..1}, {"relative": d} |
| `layout.y` | `AxisPosition` | a number (distance from the start) or {"start": d}, {"end": d}, {"start": a, "end": b}, {"align": -1..1}, {"relative": d} |
| `layout.align` | `Alignment` | [x, y] from -1 to 1, or a name: topLeft, topCenter, topRight, centerLeft, center, centerRight, bottomLeft, bottomCenter, bottomRight |
| `layout.order` | `int` | a whole number |
| `layout.basis` | `double` | a number |
| `decoration.fills` | `List<Paint>` | a list of Paint objects |
| `decoration.strokes` | `List<Paint>` | a list of Paint objects |
| `decoration.strokeWidth` | `double` | a number |
| `decoration.strokeAlign` | `StrokeAlign` | one of its names ([StrokeAlign](#enum-StrokeAlign)) |
| `decoration.strokeSides` | `StrokeSides` | one of its names ([StrokeSides](#enum-StrokeSides)) |
| `decoration.strokeCap` | `StrokeCap` | one of its names ([StrokeCap](#enum-StrokeCap)) |
| `decoration.dashPattern` | `List<double>` | a list of double objects |
| `decoration.radius` | `BorderRadius` | a number (every corner), [x, y] (every corner elliptical) or [topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft] (each a number or [x, y]) |
| `decoration.effects` | `List<Effect>` | a list of Effect objects |
| `decoration.clip` | `Clip` | one of its names ([Clip](#enum-Clip)) |
| `decoration.blendMode` | `BlendMode` | one of its names ([BlendMode](#enum-BlendMode)) |
| `decoration.foregroundFills` | `List<Paint>` | a list of Paint objects |
| `decoration.shape` | `DecorationShape` | one of its names ([DecorationShape](#enum-DecorationShape)) |

`props.<prop>` takes what the prop's type is written as ([node types](nodes.md), [value types](values.md)): `"${= open ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal'}"` for `props.direction`, a TextStyle object or a theme style's name for `props.style`. A theme color's name is not read from a formula: give `${theme.colors.ember}` (its value).

## Every bindable field

- `layout.<field>`: `width`, `height`, `constraints`, `margin`, `padding`, `rotation`, `aspectRatio`, `flex`, `squeezable`, `x`, `y`, `align`, `order`, `basis`, and `widthFactor`, `heightFactor`.
- `decoration.<field>`: `fills`, `strokes`, `strokeWidth`, `strokeAlign`, `strokeSides`, `strokeCap`, `dashPattern`, `radius`, `effects`, `clip`, `blendMode`, `foregroundFills`, `shape`. Inside `fills`, `strokes`, `foregroundFills` and `effects`, select an item by `[index]`, by its `id`, or every item by `*`, then a field of [Paint](#type-Paint) or [Effect](#type-Effect) (`decoration.fills[0].color`, `decoration.effects.*.color`, `.offset.dx`).
- `props.<prop>`: any prop of the node's type ([node types](#page-nodes)), and `props.<prop>.<field>` for a field of a model prop.
- `<behavior>` and `<behavior>.<field>`: `motion`, `scale`, `animations`, `transitions`, `shimmer`, `inkWell`, `states`, `tooltip`, `ignorePointer`, `floating`, `hero`, `flightKey`, `flight`, `draggable`, `dropTarget`, `track`, `dismissible`, `pan`, `reorderHandle`, `reveal`, `strokePath`, `typewriter`, `particles`, `textDirection`, `flip`, `tilt`, `transformGesture`, `sticky`, `viewProgress`, `measure`, `customPaint`.

## Scopes

Names an expression may start with besides the screen's variables: `data`, `route`, `storage`, `screen`, `theme`, `item`, `index`, `parent`, `result`, `loop`, `auth`, `drag`, `perf`, `track`, `dismiss`, `pan`, `transform`, `flip`, `tilt`, `view`, `sticky`, `script`, `speech`, `pageOffset`.

<a id="page-formulas"></a>
# Formula functions

The functions a formula (`${= ...}`) can call, extracted from the SDK's formula engine
(`FormulaEvaluator.functionDocs`). Formulas also have arithmetic (`+ - * / %`), comparisons (`== != < <= > >=`),
`&&`, `||`, `!`, `cond ? a : b`, string and number literals (`'text'`, `"text"`, `3.5`), lists (`[1, 2]`), paths
(`user.name`, `items[0]`), and lambdas for list functions (`x => x.price`).

Formulas are written inside JSON strings, so a backslash in a formula (a regular expression's `\d`) is written
twice in the JSON: `"${= matches(code, '^\\d{4}$')}"`. A text that is exactly one formula keeps the value's type;
inside other text a number is printed without trailing zeros (`${= 2.50}` prints `2.5`).

Source: codelessly_sdk lib/src/runtime/expressions/formula.dart (FormulaEvaluator.functionDocs, FormulaEvaluator.functions).

| `with` | `with(map, key, value, …)` | `with(item, 'x', item.x + 1) → item with x changed` |
| `at` | `at(list, index) or at(map, key)` | `at(drafts, '' + ticketId)` |
| `flatMap` | `flatMap(list, item => list)` | `flatMap(orders, o => o.items) → every item` |

<a id="page-variables-conditions-scripts"></a>
# Variables, conditions and scripts

Variables, conditions and scripts live at the top of a layout document, keyed by canvas id
(`"variables": {"<canvas id>" | "page_variables": [...]}`, `"conditions": {"<canvas id>": [...]}`), or as a list
(`"scripts"`). See the guide's [variables](#guide-variables) and
[conditions](#guide-conditions) sections for examples.

## Variable fields

| Key | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `"v1"` |  |
| `name` | `"count"` | Unique in its scope; what expressions read (`${name}`). |
| `type` | `"integer"` |  |
| `value` | `3` | The default value, as `type` holds it (see `VariableType.coerce`); null when unset. |
| `formula` | `"a + 1"` | The expression (what goes in `${= ...}`) that computes the value of a computed variable; empty for a plain one. A computed variable is read-only: it changes when what its formula reads changes. |
| `parameters` | `["a"]` | A computed variable with parameters is a function: formulas call it by name (`clamp01(x)`), and its `formula` reads the arguments by these names. |
| `options` | `["a"]` | The options of a `VariableType.choice` variable. |
| `persist` | `true` | Whether the app keeps the value on the device: it starts from the value it had last time (not `value`) and every change is saved. A draft, a list the user builds up. A computed variable can't persist (`persists`). |

### Variable types

`integer`, `text`, `decimal`, `boolean`, `color`, `list`, `map`, `image`, `choice`

## Conditions

An if / else-if / else rule. Its first branch whose test holds and that sets a property gives the property its value; when none does, the property keeps its binding's or its own value. JSON:

```json
{"id": "c1", "name": "Low stock", "branches": [
  {"when": {"left": "${stock}", "op": "lessThan", "right": "5"},
   "set": [{"node": "badge", "path": "visible", "value": true}]},
  {"set": [{"node": "badge", "path": "visible", "value": false}]}]}

```

- Branch: One branch: when `when` holds (always, for an `else`: null), the properties in `sets` take their values.
- Set entry: Sets property `path` (a binding path, DESIGN.md §5.1) of node `node` to `value`: a JSON value, where a string is an expression read like a binding's (`${= qty * 2}`, `#FF0000`, `Hello ${name}`).
- Comparison: `left op right` (the right side only for ops that `ConditionOp.takesRight`).
- Junction: All of `parts` (`and`) or any of them (`or`). Every part is evaluated. JSON: `{"and": [...]}` / `{"or": [...]}`.
- Operand: One side of a `Comparison`: an expression text whose `${...}` are read (`${count}`, `${= a + b}`, `3`, `done`), or, when `raw`, a literal taken as written. Both are then parsed loosely (`3` is a number, `true` a bool, `[1, 2]` a list). JSON: the text, or `{"raw": text}`.

### Comparison ops

| op | Reads right | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `equalsTo` | yes |  |
| `notEqualsTo` | yes |  |
| `greaterThan` | yes |  |
| `lessThan` | yes |  |
| `greaterThanOrEqualTo` | yes |  |
| `lessThanOrEqualTo` | yes |  |
| `isEmpty` | no | Null, or an empty text, list or map. |
| `isNotEmpty` | no |  |
| `contains` | yes | A list holds the right operand, a text contains it, a map has it as a key. |
| `isOdd` | no |  |
| `isEven` | no |  |
| `isNull` | no | Null, or the text `null`. |
| `isTrue` | no |  |
| `isFalse` | no |  |

## Scripts

- `id`: String = `""`
- `name`: String = `""`
- `description`: String = `""`
- `params`: Object = unset
- `source`: String = `""`
- `version`: int = `1`
- `capabilities`: List<String> = `[]`
- `timeoutMs`: int = `1000` (≥ 1)
- `memoryLimitMb`: int = `32` (≥ 1)
- `pageId`: String = unset
- `tests`: Object = unset

## Breakpoints

- `id`: String = `""`
- `name`: String = `""`
- `minWidth`: double = `0` (≥ 0)
- `width`: double = `0` (≥ 0)
- `height`: double = `0` (≥ 0)

Defaults:

| id | name | minWidth | design width × height |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mobile` | Mobile | 0 | 390 × 844 |
| `tablet` | Tablet | 600 | 834 × 1112 |
| `desktop` | Desktop | 1024 | 1440 × 900 |
